# `media/codecs/H264Pcm.js`

> **Source:** `engine/media/codecs/H264Pcm.js`

Independently authored H.264 Constrained Baseline subset: progressive 8-bit 4:2:0, one all-I_PCM IDR slice per picture, no entropy-coded residuals, no prediction, no FMO, and deblocking disabled. This valid standards subset is deliberately uncompressed; it is NOT a general H.264 decoder.
